distinguishing_features: Uses oscillating coolant fluid as an inertial absorber intended to counteract spindle-mode vibration.
Integrates the proposed absorber with the spindle coolant circuit and uses a valve controlled by spindle load.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce spindle-tool vibration near chatter frequencies during cutting.
parsed.viable_reason: As written, the fluid column is not mechanically coupled to the spindle and has no specified compliant element to tune, while the stated stiffness relation is dimensionally incorrect, so the circuit cannot be shown to act as the claimed tuned-mass damper.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: None of the cited monitoring approaches suggests converting a coolant circuit into a mode-tuned inertial absorber, which is a distinct step from monitoring resonance or bearing instability.
